description: Costos de Racionamiento de Energía Eléctrica is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Unidad de Planeación Minero Energética - UPME, Bogotá D.C.. Este conjunto de datos contiene los datos de Costos Incrementales Operativos de Racionamiento de Energía. Coverage: Colombia. The portal files it under the publisher Unidad de Planeación Minero Energética - UPME, Bogotá D.C.. Its tags are racionamiento, costos, energia. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Minas y Energía. The portal shows 2026-09-09 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
